name: Zoho

rounds.name: Written Round (C / Aptitude)
rounds.detail: C output-predict questions, pointers, arrays and a few logical puzzles.

rounds.name: Advanced Programming Round
rounds.detail: Build a mini application (console or UI) - design, code and demo your own solution.

rounds.name: Technical + HR Discussion
rounds.detail: Own project code walked line by line; favourite subject deep-dived.

aptitudePatterns.sample: printf("%d", sizeof(++i) + sizeof(i++)); - what prints and why?
Given char *s = "hello"; and char a[] = "hello"; explain the difference in mutability.
8 balls, one heavier, a balance scale - minimum weighings?

codingPatterns.sample: In 5 hours, build a bus reservation system with add/cancel/print-PNR features.
Generate all permutations of a string, avoiding duplicates.
Print a spiral matrix and a character-frequency histogram.

hrQuestions: Show and explain a piece of code you are genuinely proud of.
Would you prefer product support, development or QA - and why?
How do you debug code you wrote a year ago?
tips: Revise C pointers, storage classes and output-prediction questions.
The programming round rewards a finishable, working app over clever unfinished design.
Be ready to modify your own project live if asked.
